# QS-PROC-01 Forging temperature control (P1)
Revision: Rev D
Plant: P1, line P1-L1
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-IH03

## Scope
This quality specification defines temperature control requirements and coil inspection cadence for Hot Forge induction billet heater EQ-P1-L1-IH03 on line P1-L1. It applies to operations, maintenance, and quality personnel responsible for heating control, monitoring, and corrective action in plant P1. Refer to MM-P1-L1-IH03, SOP-P1-L1-01, and SOP-P1-L1-04 for maintenance and operational routines.

## Requirements
| Item | Requirement |
|------|-------------|
| Temperature control system | Maintain stable control of furnace/induction heater per SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-04 |
| Coil inspection interval | The coil inspection interval for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 290 hours. |
| Recordkeeping | Logs shall reference EQ-P1-L1-IH03 and be retained per MM-P1-L1-IH03 |

## Inspection method
Visual and functional inspections shall be conducted as described in MM-P1-L1-IH03 and SOP-P1-L1-04. Inspectors shall:
- Verify coil integrity and insulation condition for EQ-P1-L1-IH03 against criteria in MM-P1-L1-IH03.
- Execute functional checks of control feedback loops per SOP-P1-L1-01.
- Enter inspection outcomes into the equipment log for EQ-P1-L1-IH03 and flag any deviations.

Schedule adherence: inspections for coil condition on EQ-P1-L1-IH03 shall be performed at the coil inspection interval stated above and documented in the equipment log. Use MM-P1-L1-IH03 for detailed checklists and acceptance criteria.

## Nonconformance handling
If inspection or monitoring indicates out-of-tolerance control, coil damage, or failed functional checks, take the heater offline and follow SOP-P1-L1-04 for isolation and SOP-P1-L1-01 for operational shutdown steps. Record the event in the EQ-P1-L1-IH03 log and initiate corrective actions per MM-P1-L1-IH03. Do not return EQ-P1-L1-IH03 to production until verifications in MM-P1-L1-IH03 and SOP-P1-L1-04 are completed and documented.
